result.summary: Found several layout and content issues, including duplicate restaurant listings, cut-off content at the screen edge, and a card cropped by the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' entries with the same delivery time, price, and image, suggesting a duplication bug or placeholder data.
issues.suggestion: Verify data source and ensure unique restaurant entries are displayed instead of duplicates.

issues.description: The third card 'Smash Bros Bu...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge of the screen, with truncated text and partial image visibility.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll/carousel spacing or card sizing so cards are either fully visible or clearly indicate scrollability (e.g., partial peek with proper padding).

issues.description: The pizza image/card at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section is abruptly cropped by the bottom navigation bar, cutting off the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add proper bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content area so the last visible card isn't obscured by the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The category filter row (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right edge, indicating more categories exist but there's no visual cue (like a fade or arrow) suggesting horizontal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade gradient or scroll indicator at the edge of horizontally scrollable lists to signal additional content.

issues.description: Generic placeholder-style food bowl icons are used for two different 'Green Bowl Poké' listings instead of distinct, realistic imagery.
issues.suggestion: Replace with actual restaurant photos or distinct icons to improve visual differentiation and realism.
